newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude breaks higher, heads for $20..
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude breaks higher, heads for $20..

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20

+ NYMEX crude may head for resistance at $20.75 and $20.85 after breaking above its recent trading range, said brokers. In ACCESS trading it broke above the $19.35 to $20.55 range it has stayed in for three weeks
NYMEX crude oil futures may climb higher on Monday chasing upside targets of $20.75 and $20.85, analysts said.
The nearby June contract ended at $20.69 a barrel on ACCESS on Monday, up 26 cents from Fridays close.
"The positive preparation prompts us to add length on any idps and join breaks higher," said brokers MeesPierson Derivatives in London.
The post-Easter high of $20.88 might also lend resistance, other brokers said.
"We still keep a careful eye on gasoline as it seems to be finally leading the market to higher levels," said MeesPierson in a market report.
The June gasoline contract ended up 0.46 cents a gallon on Friday's close at 63.35 cents on ACCESS on Monday. This is the third successive gain from a low of 59.75 hit by the contract last Wednesday.
Resistance is at 63.90 and then 64.50, a recent high, said brokers.
Heating oil tracked other contracts higher on ACCESS but was thin.
June ended up 0.43 cents at 54.95 cents a gallon but will meet resistance at 55.45 and 55.80, brokers said.
"Buy on dips towards 54.00 or join any breaks higher," said MeesPierson.
